agenda.title: The Oath of Office
agenda.description: Republic Square. The Constitution. Sixty thousand people in the cold. The swearing-in ceremony marks the end of the Halvek era.

agenda.title: The First Briefing
agenda.description: Vyktor has prepared a full situation report. The economy, the Assembly, the neighbors. Everything you inherit starts here.

agenda.title: Family Dinner
agenda.description: Jonas has arranged dinner at the residence. The first night as Chancellor.
